hooks.name: House rules UI check
hooks.description: Reviews UI edits against Sootsayer's product house rules.

action.prompt: A web UI file was just saved. Check the change against the house rules in .kiro/steering/product.md, without editing anything: (1) real data only, no mock, sample, or hard-coded outlook numbers; (2) every estimate shown to users carries its 95% range and a source; (3) the method limits stay visible next to the numbers; (4) a failed or stale source is named on screen and its data is never shown as current; (5) user-facing text lives in web/src/i18n.ts with Bahasa Indonesia and English. Reply with one line "PASS" or a short list of concrete problems with file and line.
